mapper.sql: id,tenant_id AS tenantId,title,script,status,created_by AS createdBy,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_complaint_empathy_script WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY status='ACTIVE' DESC,created_at,id
SELECT FROM crm_complaint_empathy_script WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT FROM crm_complaint_empathy_script WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_complaint_empathy_script WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_complaint_empathy_script WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND title=#{title}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_complaint_empathy_script SET title=#{title},script=#{script}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE crm_complaint_empathy_script SET status='DISABLED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
